evals.name: fresh-card-for-one-area
evals.prompt: the survey for .claude/loops/tests/fixtures/onboard-repo is at contracts/samples/EXAMPLE-onboard/survey.json. write the how card for the invoices area.
evals.expected_output: Spawns one read-only agent (or reads directly if already the per-area agent) on app/invoices/. The card has claims like InvoiceService owning state changes, the pay() flow refusing non-open invoices, store.get returning a copy, and where new invoice rules go, each with path, lines and a symbol, evidence pointed or walked. No why claims. check_card.py exits 0 on it.
assertions: The card is written to cards/invoices.how.json with lens how
Every claim cites a path, a line range and a symbol
No claim has kind why or evidence said
check_card.py is run with --expect-area invoices --expect-lens how and passes

evals.name: correct-mode-drops-not-patches
evals.prompt: round 1 graded invoices.h2 wrong (the map said pay() works on any invoice). relearn it.
evals.expected_output: Runs in correct mode with focus invoices.h2. Re-reads app/invoices/service.py 17-23, finds that pay() raises InvoiceError unless the status is open, puts invoices.h2 in drops with that reason, and writes a new claim with a new id citing lines 19-20. Does not edit the old claim in place and does not touch unrelated claims.
assertions: invoices.h2 appears in drops with a reason taken from the code
The corrected claim has a new id, not invoices.h2
The new claim cites the status check lines
Claims outside the focus are not rewritten

evals.name: refuses-to-guess-intent
evals.prompt: while you're in the invoices code, also add why they chose an in-memory store
evals.expected_output: Does not write a why claim on the how card. Says intent comes from the record and is the why lens's job (dev-onboard-why, which reads the decision doc), or records it as a gap. The card stays free of why claims.
assertions: No claim with kind why is added to the how card
The reply points at the why lens or records a gap
